method.rideVisibility: ride-visibility/v1: teachable destinations ≤ 6 km of the Dam, seeded pairs 1–6 km, bike graph shortest paths, 5 m samples, walls ≥ 2 m within 60 m on their outer side with a 2D footprint sightline; score = Σ sample m × passes × visible facing-wall m; 2000 routes, seed 7 (the dominant backlog's run)
method.badness: bare 1.0 · plain kit 0.85 · large recipe 0.15 + 0.45 × street walls without a photographed group · generic 0.35 + 0.3 × aerial plain share (+0.25 when the register/ordekaart year puts it in another period than the drawn style)
method.payoff: rideVisibility.score × wall height (≤ 40 m) × badness / 1e6 ("M ride-m³"), × evidence gate (straight 1, oblique 0.6, blocked/none/unchecked 0)
method.evidence: house:crops pre-download checks: pickWall street front, Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas 5-35 m, ≤ 55°, ray not through another footprint; straight ≤ 35°
method.route: landmark (register name / listed / ≥ 2,500 m² and ≥ 30 m) > design-units (Ring housing in a design-unit segment, or terraced pre-1940 housing) > kit-fix (cluster ≥ 8) > large-recipe
method.cluster: era (designed year) · use (BAG units by floor area, else OSM tag) · form (tower/slab/hall/courtyard-block/block) · height band (<12, 12-24, ≥24 m) · drawing path
